The band's other end becomes ONE long, CHUNKY molten gold BAR: a solid, glossy, organic rod, gently wavy like poured metal, about 2mm thick along its length and swelling to rounded droplet ends about 3mm across, about 25mm long. The bar is THICK: about a third of the marquise's width, a bold rod that carries one long bright highlight down its length. The marquise sits beside the lower half of the bar, and the bar's upper half rises well past the marquise's tip. The marquise and the bar lie side by side and parallel, both in line with the band; on the finger both lie ACROSS the finger. Exactly one stone, a clear marquise, never round, oval or pear; no pave, no halo; the bar is smooth polished gold with soft ripples, never a straight machined bar, never thin like a wire, never set with stones; the band does not close. The band NEVER crosses behind the marquise and the bar at right angles: never a cross or plus shape.

SCALE TEST: On the finger the marquise is about two thirds of the finger's width long; the bar is about one and a half finger widths long, running across the ring finger and on over the neighbouring finger, and about a tenth of the finger's width thick: a bold rod, never a wire. Never larger than this. The marquise is clearly SHORTER than the finger is wide: about two thirds of it, never more. The ring keeps the size it has in IMAGE 2 against the finger, never larger.

ABSENCE LIST: No face. No second piece of jewellery, no other rings, no watch, no bag, no strap, no props. No nail polish colour. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame.
